stage: DP0-A - proposed repair plan (Gate-1 deliverable; NOT implemented)
head: 01f6f11
status: proposal only - requires explicit owner acceptance before DP0-B
primary_root_cause: DeepSeek thinking mode runs by default; the current request omits the toggle, reasoning tokens consume 72% of the 1800-token output budget, JSON truncates (finish_reason=length), and thinking-mode latency pushes the correction attempt past the 30s timeout.

proposed_changes.change: Add thinking={"type": "disabled"} to the structured-feedback request payload
proposed_changes.why: PROVEN_PRIMARY: Probe B with this single change returned finish_reason=stop in 10.85s with 764 completion tokens and zero reasoning tokens; Probe A without it truncated at 1800 tokens (1300 reasoning).
proposed_changes.scope: applies only to this provider adapter, which serves only the structured-feedback path; no global thinking policy change; no reasoning content exposed or stored

proposed_changes.change: Capture response metadata and classify truncation
proposed_changes.old_value: response id, returned model, finish_reason, usage, content length discarded before parsing
proposed_changes.new_value: Retain response id, returned model, finish_reason, usage (prompt/completion/total/reasoning), content length, and duration in last_request_metadata; raise ProviderOutputError with reason_code provider_output_truncated when finish_reason=length; emit a sanitized structured log line per call (no credentials, essay, prompt, or reasoning content)
proposed_changes.why: Answers DP0-A question C; enables the DP0-B acceptance evidence (finish_reason, token headroom) without any database migration or schema change

proposed_changes.change: Add provider-specific structured-feedback timeout as configuration
proposed_changes.old_value: timeout hardcoded at 30.0s (constructor default; factory passes nothing)
proposed_changes.new_value: settings field deepseek_timeout: float = 60.0 (env DEEPSEEK_TIMEOUT); factory passes it to DeepSeekProvider
proposed_changes.why: D0 correction attempts timed out at 30s; Probe A initial attempt took 27.05s under thinking mode. 60s is the smallest evidence-supported value with real headroom (Probe B: 10.85s), stays within the 30-90s policy bound, and keeps two attempts at <=120s < 150s.
proposed_changes.scope: provider-specific and configuration-driven; frontend timeouts, health checks, and other provider timeouts unchanged

proposed_changes.old_value: DeepSeekProvider(api_key, base_url, model, max_tokens=...); timeout default 30.0
proposed_changes.why: Wires the configuration value into the transport

unchanged_by_proposal.max_tokens: 1800 (unchanged - Probe B used 764 tokens; 1800 provides 135% headroom; DP0-B records per-case remaining headroom and may only raise to the smallest evidence-supported value within 4096 if headroom <20%)
unchanged_by_proposal.active_configuration_version: config-v0.9.0 (unchanged - no ConfigurationPayload field changes; timeout lives in Settings/env)
unchanged_by_proposal.router_retry_policy: unchanged (one correction attempt; request failures not retried; fallback preserved)

expected_impact.correction_attempt_latency: well under 30s with thinking disabled; total two-attempt budget <=120s
expected_impact.completion_tokens: ~764 (Probe B) vs 1800 hard stop (Probe A): ~58% fewer output tokens; cost reduction direction only, exact cost not estimated
expected_impact.headroom: >=100% on the frozen D0-01 case (764 of 1800)

time_budgets.interaction: end-to-end submission = analysis (~seconds) + provider (<=120s) + persistence; remains below 180s

observability_additions: last_request_metadata: response_id, returned_model, finish_reason, usage tokens, content length, duration
sanitized structured log line per provider call (attempt index, duration, finish_reason, token counts, parse status, validation status, classification code)
